description: Points d'accès publics WIFI is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Nevers. List of free Wi-Fi points accessible to the public in the municipality of Nevers. Coverage: Ville de Nevers. The portal shows the English title as "Public WIFI access points" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Nevers. Its keywords include hotspot, hotspots, wifi-public, wifi, internet-acces, nevers. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, ODS. The listing shows 2017-06-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
